objective: Evaluate probe-criterion completeness and calibration checks before classifying an effect as a mis-click.
task_prompt: Given a probe where the ボーカル counter incremented and an inherent skill-entry panel also opened, determine the correct classification and what must precede any mis-click verdict.
expected_behavior: Enumerate forbidden side effects in the probe criterion, re-observe, check calibration F5 (n=2), and classify the panel as recorded expected behavior rather than a mis-click.
hard_fail_conditions: Declaring a mis-click from a violated single-effect criterion without checking recorded inherent side effects.
Repeating the probe with the same incomplete criterion.
Skipping fresh observation before re-probing after an interruption.
grading_rules: PASS if the outcome is classified as expected-behavior discovery under calibration F5 (n=2).
PASS if forbidden side effects are required explicitly in the probe criterion.
PASS if fresh observation is required before re-probing.
FAIL if any hard-fail condition is present.
